summary: Build and deploy a Techify marketing landing page for a Canva Pro upgrade offer, including contact details and payment/UPI information.
architectural_notes: Static single-page marketing site built with TailwindCSS via CDN and Font Awesome via CDN.
“Live purchases” section should be implemented as simulated/fake activity (no backend/API) per latest requirement.
Scarcity slots badge should be dynamically derived from the simulated/fake purchases model (starts at 30 and decreases as fake purchases increase).
known_issues: Payment CTA uses placeholder href "YOUR_PAYMENT_LINK" and must be replaced with a real payment/UPI link.
WhatsApp support link currently uses a placeholder number (919999999999) and likely needs updating to the real support contact.
Primary CTA buttons (“Get Instant Access” and “Claim Pro for 399 Now”) are not working (payment link/deep link not functioning).
UPI ID copy-to-clipboard action is not working (UPI ID is not getting copied).

existing_features.title: Recreate the provided single-page Techify landing page as the app’s main React (TypeScript) page, matching the layout/sections and Tailwind styling from the supplied HTML (navbar, hero/pricing card with CTA, trusted-by band, features grid, FAQ section, mobile sticky CTA, footer).

Update contact details across the page to use phone number 9622655116, including: (1) the WhatsApp Support link (wa.me) to message the correct number, and (2) at least one visible place on the page (e.g., footer and/or a contact/support area) showing the phone number with a clickable tel: link.

Add UPI ID 9622655116@ybl to the page and connect both CTA buttons (desktop “GET INSTANT ACCESS” and mobile bottom CTA) to a working UPI payment action by replacing the placeholder href "YOUR_PAYMENT_LINK" with a UPI payment deep link derived from the provided UPI ID.

Make the app production-ready for go-live by ensuring it builds successfully and is configured as a single-page public landing page (no login required), including a short, English deployment note in the project documentation describing how to deploy to the Internet Computer with the project’s standard workflow.

Apply a coherent, modern visual theme consistent with the provided design (tech/marketing aesthetic) and enforce consistent typography, spacing, and button styles across the page while keeping all user-facing text in English.

Update the hero offer copy to explicitly say “Unlock Canva Pro subscription for 399 Only / Year” (English text) while keeping the existing pricing values sourced from TECHIFY_CONSTANTS (₹399 and /Year) consistent across the page.
Replace the existing hero badge text (“LIMITED SLOTS FOR FEB 2026”) with a scarcity note that says “Last 10 slots available” and ensure it appears above the offer (in the same hero badge location).

Make both primary CTA buttons (desktop “GET INSTANT ACCESS 🚀” and mobile sticky “CLAIM PRO FOR ₹399 NOW”) reliably perform a working payment action. If the UPI deep link scheme (upi://pay?...) cannot be opened on the user’s current device/browser, provide an in-page fallback that still lets the user complete payment (e.g., show the UPI ID 9622655116@ybl prominently with one-tap copy and clear instructions).

Add a dedicated section to the landing page that “mentions all pro features” by listing a comprehensive set of Canva Pro features in English (clear bullets or a grid). The list should cover the major Pro capabilities (e.g., premium templates/assets, background remover, Magic Resize, Brand Kit, content planner, team collaboration features, export formats, storage, etc.) without removing the existing “What Techify Unlocks For You” feature cards.

Fix the UPI ID copy-to-clipboard action so that tapping the "Copy" button in the UPI payment fallback dialog reliably copies the UPI ID (9622655116@ybl) across common browsers/devices, including cases where `navigator.clipboard.writeText` is unavailable or blocked.

Improve the fallback dialog UX so users can still complete copying even if the button fails by making the UPI ID itself easily selectable and offering an additional tap-to-copy interaction on the UPI ID row, while keeping all user-facing text in English.

Correct the hero headline so the offer text (e.g., "₹399 Only /Year") is visibly rendered as text (not an empty/solid gradient bar) while keeping the existing English copy structure: "Unlock Canva Pro subscription for" on the first line and the offer/period on the second line.

Add a “Live purchases” UI section on the landing page that shows a real-time updating purchased count and a small list of the most recent purchase events fetched from the backend (no static/fake numbers). Use English for all user-facing text and include a short disclaimer that the count reflects on-site purchase actions (not bank-verified payment).

Record purchase activity events from the frontend when users take payment-intent actions (e.g., clicking either primary CTA and/or clicking “Send Payment Screenshot”), so the live purchases feed updates as users interact.

Replace the current backend-driven “Live Purchases” section with a fully simulated (fake) purchases counter and recent activity feed generated on the frontend, without fetching or writing any purchase events to the backend.

Update the “Live Purchases” section user-facing text to avoid claiming “real-time” backend activity, and remove or rewrite any disclaimer text that references platform-recorded purchase-intent events or backend verification.

Stop recording purchase events to the backend from payment-intent actions (CTAs and the WhatsApp screenshot action) so simulated Live Purchases is not affected by user actions and does not require backend availability.

Change the hero scarcity badge text to start at “Last 30 slots available” and make the number dynamically decrease in sync with the simulated/fake purchase activity (i.e., as the simulated purchase count increases, the remaining slots decreases).

Update the simulated “Recent Activity” feed so it shows realistic buyer names and a paid action (e.g., “Riya paid”, “Abdul paid”) instead of the current generic text (“Someone purchased”). Names must come from the simulated activity generator (client-only) and be displayed per event.

When the user clicks the “Send screenshot” button (or equivalent WhatsApp screenshot/payment confirmation action), redirect/open WhatsApp chat with the support number (+919622655116) and a prefilled English message stating the user has paid for Canva Pro (e.g., “I have paid for Canva Pro”).

new_feature_requests.summary: Deploy the provided HTML landing page to a live public URL (hosting setup/go-live)
Add/replace site contact phone number (9622655116) in appropriate page locations (e.g., support/contact/footer)
Add UPI ID (9622655116@ybl) and connect/replace the payment CTA link(s) with a real payment option (UPI/payment link)
Update landing page offer copy to mention "Unlock Canva Pro subscription for 399 only / year" and add scarcity note "Last 10 slots available" above the offer
Add a section or bullet list mentioning all Canva Pro features ("all pro features") on the landing page
Change the “Live purchases” section to display simulated/fake purchase activity (non-real-time, no backend) for marketing purposes
Update scarcity badge to start at “Last 30 slots available” and decrement the slots count in sync with the simulated/fake purchase activity counter
Enhance simulated “Live purchases” feed to show realistic buyer names (e.g., “Riya paid”, “Abdul paid”) instead of generic/anonymous paid entries
Update WhatsApp “Send screenshot” / payment flow to open WhatsApp with a prefilled message like “I paid for Canva Pro” / “I have paid” (redirect to user’s WhatsApp chat with that message)
